## Essence words

code, hidden truth, simulation, awakening, signal in noise, control

## Look

Near-black green, falling glyph columns with a bright lead glyph, phosphor bloom. A "real world" chapter switches the grade to cold steel blue (`--tx-a3`). **Build the rain from the subject's own material** (its keywords, hex of its data, its numerals), never a borrowed glyph set. This is the theme's uniqueness lever.

## Motion grammar

Columns fall at varied speeds; headings decode out of noise; one "freeze-orbit" moment where scroll stops time and circles a single data point. Decodes run 600 to 900 ms.

## Data skin

5-step monochrome green ramp, mono numerals, glyph-noise texture in empty chart space at 5%.

## Video

Black frame with a blinking cursor, rain resolving into the title, green "inside" scenes cut against steel-blue "outside" scenes, a freeze-orbit shot for the key stat. Low industrial pulse with glitch percussion, 90 to 100 BPM.

## Boardroom translation

Rain only in the hero at 15% opacity or less, frozen after 3 s; decode accents on KPIs only.

## Homage guardrails

Rain glyphs come from the subject, never a borrowed or mirrored glyph set. No two-pill choice motif, no figures in long coats and dark glasses, no phone-booth exits, no film dialogue. These sit on top of the [Homage Rule](../codex/homage-rule.md).

## Collision note

Sits near threat-intel builds with spectrogram or heap-grid signatures. Vary the S1 family if either shipped in the last two builds.
